paragraphs.text:
1 Paranoia. When you meet helpful people, you may not accept
their Food or healing.
2 Eating Disorder. You require 1 Food every 3 boxes.

3
Absent Mindedness . Every time you need a material
component for a ritual or a tool for a task, excluding weapons,
roll d6. On a 1, that tool or object is unavailable. If you have a
Safe House in play, you left that item at the Safe House. If you
have no Safe House in play, the item is lost.
4 Phobic. You have -1 on all rolls made to avoid losing Sanity or
to resist Fear effects of any kind.
5 Overconfidence. You may not make an Escape roll unless you
are down to just 1 or 2 Life points.
6 Shaky. Your maximum Sanity is permanently lowered by 1.
